user.title: Connect to your UniFi console
user.description: Use a dedicated local-only UniFi OS account with the Super Admin role and no two-factor authentication. Alarm Manager is not available to custom roles.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the UniFi console running Protect.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this off unless the console has a certificate Home Assistant trusts.

profiles.title: Map arm modes to Protect profiles
profiles.description: Choose which Alarm Manager profile each Home Assistant arm mode arms. Arm home and arm night are optional.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with {host}
reauth_confirm.description: The console rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current username and password of the Super Admin account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure connection
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches the console. It must be the same console as before.

error.mfa_not_supported: This account uses two-factor authentication. Use a local-only account without two-factor authentication.
error.rate_limited: Too many failed logins. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the console.
error.not_super_admin: This account needs the Super Admin role. Alarm Manager is not available to custom roles.
error.global_mode_off: Protect's Alarm Manager is not in Global mode on this console.
error.no_profiles: No arm profiles found. Create one in Protect's Alarm Manager first.
error.duplicate_profile: Each profile can only be used for one arm mode.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this console is already in progress.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: These details belong to a different console than the one originally configured.

init.title: Arm mode mapping
init.description: Choose which Alarm Manager profile each Home Assistant arm mode arms. Arm home and arm night are optional.

error.duplicate_profile: Each profile can only be used for one arm mode.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be running to change the arm mode mapping.
abort.no_profiles: No arm profiles found on the console. Create one in Protect's Alarm Manager first.

not_super_admin.title: UniFi alarm account is not a Super Admin
not_super_admin.description: The console refused access to Alarm Manager. Give the account used by UniFi Protect Alarm Bridge the Super Admin role again; custom roles cannot use Alarm Manager. This issue clears itself on the next successful poll.

api_changed.title: UniFi Alarm Manager returned unexpected data
api_changed.description: The console (Protect {protect_version}) returned data this integration does not understand, probably after a firmware update. Please report it at {issue_url} and attach a diagnostics download.

global_mode_off.title: Protect Alarm Manager is not in Global mode
global_mode_off.description: This integration controls Protect's Global Alarm Manager, but the console reports that Global mode is off. Switch Alarm Manager back to Global mode in Protect, or use the official UniFi Protect integration while in Local mode.

push_unavailable.title: Instant UniFi alarm updates are unavailable
push_unavailable.description: The Protect update websocket has been disconnected for over an hour, so the alarm state is only refreshed every 10 seconds. This usually follows a firmware change. Please report it at {issue_url} if it persists.

profile_missing.title: Mapped UniFi arm profile no longer exists

init.title: Choose arm profiles again
init.description: A Protect arm profile used by Home Assistant was deleted or replaced. Choose which profile each arm mode should use.

error.duplicate_profile: Each profile can only be used for one arm mode.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be running to fix this.
abort.no_profiles: No arm profiles found on the console. Create one in Protect's Alarm Manager first.

profile_missing.message: The Protect arm profile mapped to this arm mode no longer exists. Fix it under Settings → Repairs.

disarm_first.message: The alarm is triggered. Disarm it before arming again.
